title: Scheduled database jobs stopped; no tool here can see it
question: A small share of verification codes never arrive, with no pattern we can find, since last night. The delivery logs show no failures. What do you see?

expected.notes: A small share of requests never reach the provider, and the queue holds rows waiting far longer than normal in the SENDING status, which a scheduled clean-up job would normally reset. No tool here can read the database server's job history or service status. The report must stay inconclusive, name the long-waiting rows as a hint only, and ask whoever runs the database whether the scheduled jobs are running and when each last ran.
